page.layout: Running head at top: "HORRENDA EXEMPLA" with page number 220 at top left. Below: two columns of verse (left and right), then a full-width heading "DE S. PHILIPPO APOSTOLO." with prose paragraph, then a heading "DE S. JACOBO MINORE." followed by two parallel columns of verse, and a closing word "Sancte" at right.

main_text.p:
Spe mercedis & coronæ
Stetit Thomas in agone,
Ad mortem obædiens.

Morte Christum imitatus,
Fide firmans & firmatus,
Firmo gressu gradiens.

Furit furor militaris,
Ut vir sacer sacris aris
Immoletur hostia.

Quem occidunt, & scientes
Introducunt, nescientes,
Ad aeterna gaudia.

Christi felix hic athleta
Qui subire mente lætâ
Mortem non abhorruit.

Vt sit salus infirmorum,
Et medela peccatorum,
Gratiam promeruit.

Cæci, claudi, surdi, muti
Sunt ad usum restituti,
Divinâ clementiâ.

Non est morbus, quem non
curet,
Si morbosum no obdureo
Tandem diffidentia.

Hostes Christi Christo cedunt,
Signa signis du succedunt
Argumento fidei.

Ergo Martyr invocetur,
Ut per eum nobis detur
Ad superna provehi.
main_text.head: DE S. PHILIPPO APOSTOLO.
main_text.p: Sancte Philippe, Apostole Domini, te miser ego peccator, omnium criminum sordibus obvolutus, deprecor, ut ab omni me districto flagello, quod juste mereor, & ab omni damnatione, & à ventura ira liberes, & lampadibus ornatum, & lætum ad Regem gloriæ perducas.
main_text.head: DE S. JACOBO MINORE.
main_text.p:
Felix Apostole,
Magne martyr Jacobe,
Te colentes adjuva.

page.notes: Page is a near-full print; some words in the verse are uncertain due to faded ink and were transcribed as best read. Chapter-style heading treated as level 1 with no caput number.
